# Rotulo

The label register, cut short by a band, set under the block it belongs to.

Status: Stable. Semantic versioning applies: nothing breaks without a deprecation first.

The label register: Archivo at `wdth` 116, in caps, cut short by a band of the layer beneath. It replaces the eyebrow, and it goes **under** the block it belongs to — read as attribution, not as a pre-announcement of what the heading is about to say better.

## Usage

### When to use

- Saying what kind of thing a block is, or who it is from, under its heading.
- A label inside a dense header, with plain, which drops the band.

### When not to

- An eyebrow above a heading; the heading says it better. Use [Heading](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-typography-heading--overview.md).
- A status. Use [Badge](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-feedback-badge--overview.md).
- The label of a form field. Use [Label](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/md/components-forms-field--overview.md).

### Do and don’t

- Do: Put the rótulo under the heading.
- Don’t: Put it above the heading as an eyebrow.
- Do: Keep the oro band for ink grounds.
- Don’t: Use oro on light cloth, where it measures 1.66:1 and disappears.

### Content

- Two or three words in sentence case; the register sets them in capitals.

## API

### `Rotulo` (component)

The label register — Archivo pushed out along its width axis, cut short by a band of the layer beneath.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `band` | `RotuloBand` | `ink` | The revealed band before the label. Defaults to ink: on light cloth gold measures 1.66:1 and the mark disappears, and rojo, the default until 2026-10, is the danger colour on a product screen (docs/adr/0008-the-rojo-register.md). Rojo stays available for editorial pages; gold is for ink grounds. |
| `plain` | `boolean` | `false` | Drop the band and keep only the lettering — for a label inside a dense header. |

Types: `RotuloBand`, `RotuloProps`

## Accessibility

Nothing in it takes focus, so there is no keyboard table.

### Mola handles

- Renders a `<p>`; the band before it is drawn in CSS and is not read.

### You handle

- Place it under the block it labels, not above a heading as an eyebrow.

### Testing status

- Automated, jsdom: each of its 3 stories is rendered and checked with axe on every pull request.
- Automated, browser: every story is checked in Chromium with axe, colour contrast included, in both themes, and for overflow at 390px.
- Keyboard in unit tests: not applicable.
- Screen readers: not yet tested by hand.
